dedupe_keys.name: multicriterial decision making the smart metering case

description: Pilo, Fabricio and colleagues document this resource through an ISGAN report deposited in Zenodo. The completed application compares advanced-metering alternatives for Italian low-voltage consumers using a combined monetary and multicriteria appraisal. A cross-platform calculation joins MCA with ISGAN cost-benefit tools. Economic effects, grid smartness and externalities define the assessment, with criteria chosen to avoid double counting. The study compares Analytic Hierarchy Process, ELECTRE III and ELECTRE III after fuzzy scoring. All identify the evolutive AMI alternative as preferred under the study assumptions, while the authors distinguish preliminary AHP appraisal from deeper ELECTRE analysis. The report contains a performed investment appraisal covering Italian low-voltage metering, not subsequent deployment of the selected option. The related existing MC-CBA case covers a separate distribution/storage-upgrade example. The report is openly available under CC-BY-4.0; these terms do not establish a software licence or public source-code release. Full descriptive metadata and file inventories were inspected. The PDF and any code or data bodies were not opened, and the calculations were not reproduced.
